CineMovie v0.9.2 Highlights:

Streaming & Anime:
• Faster, more reliable streaming with upgraded servers and automatic backup switching.
• Watch Japanese anime with original Japanese audio and automatic English subtitles.
• Cleaner audio & quality menus, smoother double-tap 20-second skip, reliable Auto-Next episodes, and improved Arabic and multi-language subtitle timing.

Offline Downloads:
• Pick your video quality before downloading, with full audio support and one-tap save to your phone gallery.
• Reliable pause and resume support, automatic recovery after closing the app, and storage space checks.

Social & Design:
• Redesigned Social Lounge: tap any friend to view their profile, watch stats, and activity on movie and show pages.
• Instant sync when marking movies or episodes as watched, plus more accurate Continue Watching progress.
• Refreshed My List, Trophies, New & Hot, and Version History screens tailored for small and large phone sizes.

Android TV & Performance:
• Smoother D-pad remote navigation and cleaner focus highlights on Android TV.
• Faster app launch, smoother scrolling, and better performance across phones and TVs.
